checks.name: exact_signed_pair_and_private_receipt
checks.run:
from pathlib import Path
from tempfile import TemporaryDirectory
from factoryline.savings import record_savings_pair
with TemporaryDirectory() as d:
    root = Path(d)
    evidence = root / 'proof.json'
    evidence.write_text('{}')
    result = record_savings_pair(root, 'exact', {'elapsed_ms': 600, 'tokens': 120, 'cost_usd': 6}, {'elapsed_ms': 300, 'tokens': 80, 'cost_usd': 4}, equivalent_outcome=True, evidence=evidence)
    assert result['savings']['time_saved_ms'] == 300
    assert result['savings']['tokens_saved'] == 40
    assert result['savings']['cost_saved_usd'] == 2
    assert result['savings']['productivity_gain_rate'] == 1
    assert Path(result['receipt']).is_file()

checks.name: unknowns_regressions_and_overwrite_fail_closed
checks.run:
from pathlib import Path
from tempfile import TemporaryDirectory
from factoryline.savings import SavingsError, record_savings_pair
with TemporaryDirectory() as d:
    root = Path(d)
    result = record_savings_pair(root, 'regression', {'elapsed_ms': 100}, {'elapsed_ms': 200})
    assert result['savings']['time_saved_ms'] == -100
    assert result['savings']['tokens_saved'] is None
    assert result['savings']['productivity_gain_rate'] is None
    try:
        record_savings_pair(root, 'regression', {'elapsed_ms': 100}, {'elapsed_ms': 200})
        raise AssertionError('overwrite allowed')
    except SavingsError as exc:
        assert exc.code == 'PAIR_OVERWRITE_REFUSED'

checks.name: aggregate_report_excludes_pair_details
checks.run:
from pathlib import Path
from tempfile import TemporaryDirectory
import json
from factoryline.savings import export_public_savings_report, record_savings_pair
with TemporaryDirectory() as d:
    root = Path(d)
    record_savings_pair(root, 'private-id', {'elapsed_ms': 100, 'tokens': 10}, {'elapsed_ms': 80, 'tokens': 8})
    out = root / 'public.json'
    export_public_savings_report(root, out)
    text = out.read_text()
    value = json.loads(text)
    assert value['schema'] == 'factory.savings-report.public.v1'
    assert value['time']['saved_total'] == 20
    assert 'private-id' not in text
    assert 'pair_id' not in text
    assert 'evidence_sha256' not in text
